title: Pentagon Publishes Seventh PURSUE UAP Records Release
summary: The Department of War announced the seventh PURSUE records release on October 23, 2026. Secondary cataloging reports 28 PDFs and no separate videos. GreyAlien has not audited the individual documents; reported contents are research leads, not independently established findings.
evidence_status: Official announcement verified; secondary 28-record/no-video inventory not independently audited; individual PDFs not inspected
